preconditions.expression: isinstance(root, TreeNode) or root is None
preconditions.description: The root must be an instance of TreeNode or None.
The sum must be a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(path, list) for path in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each path in the return value must be a list.

postconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(node_val, int) for node_val in path) for path in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each element in a path must be an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(path) == sum for path in return_value)
postconditions.description: The sum of elements in each path must equal the given sum.

postconditions.expression: all(any(node_val == root.val for node_val in path) for path in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each path must start with the root value.
